scope: IQ2 address calculation experiment versus frozen halfword-load baseline and pinned mx Vulkan c4d12e2c0. P512/G128, same released file per format, F32 KV, auto F16, ubatch 512, 4 threads. Each format retains 3 total warmups and 12 measured calls (four per arm); final profile is separate diagnostic output. Small screen only, not full qualification or merge pass.

shader_hygiene_carry_forward.initial_failure: The first shader build failed because matmul_tile_q.comp used the IQ2_SMALL_HALF conditional while its integer tile_q path did not bind that macro. This failure is retained. The follow-up changes only explicit byte-accessor bindings in the affected tile and embedding paths; the row path remains explicitly 16-bit. The rebuilt shader set is byte-identical to the tested address-v1 set.
shader_hygiene_carry_forward.limits: This proves compiled shader include identity for this hygiene overlay; it is not a new numerical or performance run.

interpretation: Higher tok/s is faster. Candidate means beat mx in both PP and TG on these measured cells. All planned observations are retained. Monitor activity overlaps many/all intervals; this supports a bounded descriptive result only, not a universal or causal claim. Released-file correctness, broader matched workload, HF and remaining qualification gates are separate.

lifecycle_provenance.state_snapshot_order: Runner records docker inspect state before docker rm -f; removed=true is recorded after successful removal. Running=true in the inspect snapshot is expected.

activity.limitations: Short-lived processes between samples may be missed; disappeared/new and inaccessible processes are retained as coverage limits. Unavailable GPU counters are not zero.
